text_block_list.text:
"During Durandal's training,
an inspection team from an overseas Tracen institute
visited the track."

text_block_list.name: Overseas Inspector
text_block_list.text: Splendid! Your running is dramatically sharper than before!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ? Um... Have we met somewhere before?

text_block_list.name: Overseas Inspector
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. Actually, I saw you the last time I visited.
I sensed your talent back then, but your growth has been remarkable.
I am certain you will become an Umamusume who leaves her name in history!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am honored by your praise.
This is entirely thanks to your guidance, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Overseas Inspector
text_block_list.text: Mm! In that case, coming to our nation's Tracen Academy holds promise for even greater leaps forward!

text_block_list.name: Overseas Inspector
text_block_list.text:
Our budget is several times larger than here!
Our facilities and staff are world-class!
With us, you can win on the world stage!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Of course, I turned it down.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"There is only one Holy Sword. And only one wielder.
I shall never serve two masters."
choice_data_list: But wouldn't the facilities be better over there?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Just to make sure we're on the same page—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Even if the other person possesses the greatest track record in the world, I refuse."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"The only one permitted to wield the Holy Sword Durandal
is the one person I have acknowledged."
